description: Explore. On the E007 recipe, capture the train step (forward, backward, Muon Newton-Schulz plus SGD update, and the EMA update on steps where it applies) in CUDA graphs. Use torch.compile mode='max-autotune' (cudagraphs on) or a manual torch.cuda.graph per resolution with static input buffers that the GPU augmentation writes into. Capture every resolution in build on synthetic data. Math stays identical.
